finding.detail: The campaign fingerprint and billed create bind n_checkpoints, learning_rate, warmup_ratio, training_method and training_type, but the refreshed-main post-create provider retrieve verification checks only training_file, validation_file, model, n_epochs, n_evals and random_seed. A provider-returned job with the same checked core identity but substituted fingerprint-bound training metadata can therefore receive created_job_identity=VERIFIED.

unusual_experiment.name: DIRECT_08B_PROVIDER_HYPERPARAMETER_SUBSTITUTION
unusual_experiment.counter_reality: Provider returns the known job id and core dataset/model identity but substitutes one fingerprint-bound training field such as learning_rate, warmup_ratio, training_type, training_method or n_checkpoints.
unusual_experiment.pre_fix_prediction: The old post-create verifier cannot reject a substituted field that is absent from its expected identity map.
unusual_experiment.post_fix_obligation: Every substituted fingerprint-bound provider-visible training field is detected as JOB_CREATED_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.

repair.preserves_parallel_main_change: canonical validate_corpus_v2 local preflight from refreshed main

primary_external_evidence.supported_model_fact: Current Together Full fine-tuning documentation lists Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B.
primary_external_evidence.retrieve_schema_fact: Current Together fine-tuning job retrieval documentation exposes learning_rate, warmup_ratio, training_method and training_type, so these create-bound fields are provider-verifiable after create.
primary_external_evidence.pricing_fact: Current public standard Full SFT pricing for models up to 16B is USD 0.54 per 1M processed tokens; exact job cost still requires provider preflight.
